prompt: How should the autumn sales forecast and the factory plan treat Pine and Ash?
promptZh: 秋季銷售預測和工廠計畫應如何處理 Pine 與 Ash？

options.text: Count both in sales demand, but reserve new production for neither.
options.zh: 把兩款都計入銷售需求，但兩款都不保留新產能。
options.whyZh: Ash 的庫存已指定供應另一個市場，本地需求須另行交貨。

options.text: Count both in sales demand, but reserve new production only for Ash.
options.zh: 把兩款都計入銷售需求，但只為 Ash 保留新產能。
options.whyZh: 兩款銷售需求都已確認；Pine 由自有貨品供應，Ash 雖然有自有庫存，但庫存另有用途，因此只為 Ash 預留產能安排新生產。

options.text: Count only Ash in sales demand and reserve new production only for Ash.
options.zh: 只把 Ash 計入銷售需求，也只為 Ash 保留新產能。
options.whyZh: Pine 不需新生產，但仍是已確認的銷售需求，不能從預測刪掉。

options.text: Count both in sales demand and reserve new production for both.
options.zh: 把兩款都計入銷售需求，並為兩款保留新產能。
options.whyZh: Pine 已確定由歇業門市調出的自有貨品供應，不用再生產。

explanationZh: 兩款銷售需求都已確認；Pine 由自有貨品供應，Ash 雖然有自有庫存，但庫存另有用途，因此只為 Ash 預留產能安排新生產。

vocabulary.note: 銷售需求仍須記下；只有現有庫存未承諾供這筆需求時，才需安排生產。

evidence: Keep confirmed sales figures even when they won’t generate factory work. / For the factory plan, set aside new production only for the demand that Rowan hasn’t committed to meeting with units it already owns. / Mara also confirmed the autumn quantities for the Pine racks and Ash cabinets. / She is moving Rowan’s Pine racks from two stores that are closing to the autumn sales locations, so she won’t take a new delivery of that model. / The Ash cabinets in Rowan’s central warehouse could cover its autumn quantity, but Mara has committed those units to a separate launch in another market. / She wants a fresh delivery to cover the forecast here.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Keep confirmed sales figures even when they won’t generate factory work.
For the factory plan, set aside new production only for the demand that Rowan hasn’t committed to meeting with units it already owns.
Mara also confirmed the autumn quantities for the Pine racks and Ash cabinets.
She is moving Rowan’s Pine racks from two stores that are closing to the autumn sales locations, so she won’t take a new delivery of that model.
The Ash cabinets in Rowan’s central warehouse could cover its autumn quantity, but Mara has committed those units to a separate launch in another market.
She wants a fresh delivery to cover the forecast here.
